metadata.title: Claude, Call Summary.
metadata.purpose: Answer one real question in the Plain register: what does the call-summary skill do, and how? Lands the carry-out that a skill is a written set of steps, not a new capability, and this one turns call notes into the same action items, follow-up email, and summary every time.

beats.narration_text: Claude doesn't hear your calls — it reads the notes you paste in and writes the summary from those. How does that actually work? Let's open the call-summary skill and look.

How does that work?

beats.narration_text: A skill is a folder Claude reads before it works. This one is called call-summary. Inside is one file — SKILL.md — written in plain language: what to do with call notes or a transcript, and when to do it. Claude reads that file, then acts.

production_viz.label: A SKILL IS A FOLDER
production_viz.caption: one file, written in plain language

beats.narration_text: The instructions are steps, and Claude runs them in order: read the call notes or transcript, pull out the action items, draft the follow-up email, generate the internal summary, then hand back the result. One pass, no branching unless a step says so.

Because the steps are fixed, the same call notes get the same treatment every run — same action-item pull, same email draft, same summary shape. Ask it for something the file doesn't cover — say, booking the follow-up meeting — and there's no instruction for that; call-summary only does what its steps describe.
A skill isn't a new power Claude has — it's a written set of steps. call-summary turns your call notes into the same action items, follow-up email, and summary, every single time.

props.quote: A skill isn't a new power Claude has — it's a written set of steps. call-summary turns your call notes into the same action items, follow-up email, and summary, every single time.

beats.narration_text: Your turn. Paste this into Claude: Read the call-summary skill and walk me through what you're about to do before you do it. Then use it on these call notes: paste your notes here — pull out the action items, draft the follow-up email, and give me the internal summary. That first line matters — watching Claude explain the plan before it runs shows you exactly which step in the skill is doing the work.
